question: The Mukhya Mantrir Jiban Anuprerana Scheme of Assam offers _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**One-time grant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mukhya Mantrir Jiban Anuprerana Scheme (MMJAS)** is a significant healthcare welfare initiative launched by the **Government of Assam** through its **Health and Family Welfare Department**.
 
• The primary objective of this scheme is to provide immediate financial relief to individuals from **low-income backgrounds** who are diagnosed with **critical or life-threatening diseases**.
 
• Under the provisions of this scheme, the assistance is provided as a **one-time grant**. This lump sum amount is meant to help the patient cover the high costs of specialized medical treatments, surgeries, or prolonged clinical care. ***Hence, option 4 is correct.***
